title: GUVI: Single Number via Bitwise XOR
description: Given a non-empty array of integers `nums`, every element appears twice except for one. Find that single one in O(N) runtime and O(1) auxiliary space.
explanation: XOR property: x ^ x = 0 and x ^ 0 = x. Accumulating XOR cancels all duplicates, isolating the single element in O(N) time and O(1) space.
